definitions.explanation: The act of doing something to pass free time, or the activity used for that purpose.

examples.japanese: {暇潰|ひまつぶ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I play games to kill time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧{暇潰|ひまつぶ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧もの⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧？
examples.english: Is there anything to pass the time with?

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{暇潰|ひまつぶ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいた→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I was reading a book to pass the time while waiting for the train.

notes:
WRITING:
Also written as ⟦{暇|ひま}つぶし→暇つぶし：16684_himatsubushi⟧ in mixed script.

USAGE:
Often used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to indicate purpose: {暇潰|ひまつぶ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do something to kill time). Can carry a slightly dismissive nuance, suggesting the activity isn't particularly important.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暇潰|ひまつぶ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do something to kill time
- {暇潰|ひまつぶ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as a pastime
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{暇潰|ひまつぶ}し: a good way to kill time
